style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, crisp shadows, high exposure
motion_rule: in every window he leaps or the toad or the roll crosses the whole frame; he never holds a pose; new shot size and camera move every window, never on a schedule; his head snaps round backwards in speech too
character: a palm-sized tarsier, grey-brown fur, thin long fingers, ENORMOUS round amber eyes, a loose office tie, alarmed
second_characters: ONE fat toad banker in a striped tie, throat ballooning, hauling the roll right at the lens all clip, never still
props: ONE honey-oak desk; ONE long paper roll of a payment schedule, ruled in blank squares; ONE round red stamp in the toad's paw; his tie; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the roll is in frame all clip, unspooling longer every window; the stamp stays in the toad's paw
environment: a sunlit bank office: tall window, honey-oak panelling, a palm

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: high squeaky male voice, alarmed, even 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: mo-EE gla-ZA, VEE-dyat, o-SO-ben-no, SRO-ki, ot-da-VAT stress last, KA-zhet-sya, u-ZHE, ZAV-tra
audio.pacing: 0.9-3.35 one breath; one pause only, 3.35-3.75; 3.75-6.85 one breath; after 6.85 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: paper unspooling, a stamp thump, a toad croak, desk rattle

timeline.a: the roll whips across the lens and clears it
he lands on the desk, the roll snaps taut under him
he rears up, eyes filling half his head, the toad leaning in
his head snaps a half turn backwards, body stays forward
he runs the roll through his fingers, it pours past the lens
no words. The toad slams the roll flat, it whips across the lens
he leaps onto the toad's shoulder, eyes straight at the lens
he walks the toad's arm at the camera till he fills it
he throws both hands overhead, the toad's throat balloons
he drops onto the desk and the paper avalanches over him
he bursts up through the paper right into the lens
no words. The roll tears loose, unspools across the whole frame
the toad slams the red stamp down, the desk jumps, paper flies
he leaps onto the toad's head, his head snaps full round backwards
he rides the paper into the lens till his face fills it
he winks and the paper roll unspools past his open eye, still running

must_appear: the toad hauling the roll at the lens, the roll unspooling longer every window, his head snapping backwards twice, he rides the paper into the camera, a wink at 9.55 with the roll still unspooling
